name: Microwave Tomato Rice with Tofu
ingredients: ⅓ cup basmati rice, rinsed and soaked 15 minutes
½ tsp mustard seeds, 6 curry leaves, 1 green chilli
½ tsp sambar or chilli powder and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: In a large bowl, microwave the oil, mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and spices; cover and microwave for 4 minutes until mushy.
Add the drained rice, tofu, water and salt. Stir.
Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes, then at 50% for 8 minutes.
Stand 5 minutes, fluff and add coriander.
note: Crumbled tofu adds protein; a small rice portion keeps the carbohydrate moderate.
